# a16z Academy — application answers

## 1. Who you are — done
First-year at Bentley, from Monterrey. I run an AI program for a 200-person manufacturer back home. Not a programmer; I built the system that runs my own week with Claude Code.

## 2. What you built — done (140 words after Priya)
A shift assistant that 31 of 38 supervisors use, trained on how they already report, not the other way around. And Exo: 28 agents that read my eleven channels every morning and leave me the five things only I can do.

## 3. Why now — done
Mid-size companies in Mexico are being sold AI by people who have never been inside a plant. The ones who win will be the ones whose people keep using it after month two.

## 4. What you would do with the Academy — open
Draft: find the ten people who have made adoption work in physical businesses and learn what they did in week three.

## 5. The hardest thing — open
Draft: being the only person in the room who cannot code and still being the one who ships.

*Deadline in nine days. Rewrite 4 and 5 tomorrow at 8:00.*
